section: Illinois corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Corporate income tax rate
note: Rate on net income, in effect since July 1, 2017. Corporations also pay the 2.5% personal property replacement tax (combined 9.5%).
source_title: Illinois Department of Revenue: Income Tax Rates

section: Illinois corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Personal property replacement tax on corporations
note: Additional tax on corporate net income (not S corporations), paid on top of the 7% income tax. Partnerships, trusts and S corporations pay 1.5%.
source_title: Illinois Department of Revenue: Income Tax Rates

label: Levied by
value: About 6,000 local government units: municipalities, townships, counties, school districts, park districts and other taxing districts
note: The state itself does not levy property tax.
source_title: Illinois Department of Revenue: PIO-16 An Overview of Property Tax (R-10/23)

label: State oversight
value: Illinois Department of Revenue (equalization factors, sales ratio studies, assessor education)
note: IDOR does not administer property tax; counties and taxing districts do. IDOR sets equalization factors and trains assessment officials.
source_title: Illinois Department of Revenue: Property Tax (Local Governments)

label: Levy growth limit (PTELL)
value: Lesser of 5% or the prior year's CPI increase, for taxing districts in counties under the Property Tax Extension Limitation Law
note: Applies in Cook, the collar counties and counties that adopted it by referendum; voters can approve higher increases. Home-rule units are not covered.
source_title: Illinois Department of Revenue: PIO-62 An Overview of the Property Tax Extension Limitation Law

label: General homestead exemption (maximum)
value: Up to $6,000 of equalized assessed value in most counties; $8,000 in counties next to Cook; $10,000 in Cook County
note: Equals the increase in the home's EAV above its 1977 EAV, capped at these amounts (35 ILCS 200/15-175).
source_title: Illinois Department of Revenue: Property Tax Relief

label: State real estate transfer tax rate
value: $0.50 per $500 of net consideration (rounded up to the next $500)
note: Illinois tax stamps, computed on Form PTAX-203 (35 ILCS 200/31-10).
source_title: Illinois Department of Revenue: Form PTAX-203 Illinois Real Property Transfer Declaration (R-10/24)

label: County real estate transfer tax rate
note: County tax stamps, added to the state tax. Home-rule cities such as Chicago levy their own additional transfer taxes.
source_title: Illinois Department of Revenue: Form PTAX-203 Illinois Real Property Transfer Declaration (R-10/24)
